title: Ondo latest-news carousel
description: An auto-advancing announcement carousel: one wide charcoal card (24px corners) with a 16px-rounded image on the left and a meta line, headline, serif excerpt and soft 'read more' button on the right, flanked on desktop by slim grey peeks of the neighbouring slides. A small ring fills over six seconds, then the next slide slides in. On phones the card stacks and two pale headline tickers loop underneath.
notes: media slot: one 570×347 image per slide; a plain surface when empty
the card forces the theme's dark colours with the dark class
autoplay stops under reduced motion; the peeks and the ring are buttons/indicators for the next slide
the excerpt reads var(--ondo-serif) and falls back to the display face in other themes
name: ondo-news
